license.nonCommercial: Permitted for research that does not seek commercial advantage.
license.noDerivatives: Internal per-tooth crown extraction for non-commercial research is permitted with attribution; do not publicly redistribute extracted subsets or adapted weights.
license.recommendedAction: Proceed under CC BY-NC with full Teeth3DS citation, private research infrastructure, and no public release of extracted crowns or candidate checkpoints.

rawFormat.annotationFormat: JSON per scan with vertex-aligned FDI labels and instance ids
rawFormat.landmarkFormat: JSON with kpt suffix for Teeth3DS+ / 3DTeethLand subset
rawFormat.mergeRule: Download all six OSF parts and merge to one folder tree before ingestion.

officialSplit.validationStrategy: Official release has train/test only. Derive validation by patient-level holdout from official train (recommended 20% of train patients, stratified by jaw). Never tune on official test.

toothCoverage.representationGoal: Minimum geometry-admitted crowns per family in train split before entering build_anatomy_training_mix; Teeth3DS does not establish clinical health status
toothCoverage.notes: Per-label counts are balanced in official train/test (~66/33 split at tooth level). Molars and incisors are well represented; use build_anatomy_training_mix minimums to enforce family floors.

pipelineMirroringFdi16.action: Verify OSF download completeness, record source.json with URLs, part ids, merge digest, license, citations.
Assign each scan key to official train, derived-validation, or official test. Persist selection_manifest.json with sourceMemberPath and officialSplit.
For each scan, group vertices by instance id, map FDI label from JSON, export one open-surface crown mesh per instance (skip label 0 gingiva).
Reuse FDI-16 QC gates plus segmentation-specific checks: gingiva bleed, brace fragments, missing crown truncation, duplicate crowns.

Build anatomy_manifest.json with groupId=patient uuid, official split, fdiNumber, toothFamily, trainingRole=anatomy-base, condition=unspecified, researchTrainingApproved=true for QMUL non-commercial research.
Same TRELLIS.2 stages as FDI-16: normalize mm, 24-view renders, ovoxel, shape latents, renders_cond, asset_stats.json.
pipelineMirroringFdi16.output: Modal volume dataset folder ready for train_anatomy::plan

pipelineMirroringFdi16.action: Combine with FDI-16 via build_anatomy_training_mix.py only after Teeth3DS researchTrainingApproved is true and family minimums pass.

trellis2Fit.inputUnit: Single open IOS crown mesh in mm, one tooth per asset
trellis2Fit.conditioning: Use fdiNumber, arch, side, toothFamily from manifest; optional landmark-assisted canonical frame from kpt JSON where available
trellis2Fit.texturePolicy: Shape flow only; do not train texture flow from untextured IOS surfaces

isolationFromProduction.promotion: Manual only via model_registry.json; production TRELLIS unchanged

steps: Download OSF parts 1-6 and merge locally or on Modal
Extract ~200 crowns stratified: ~50 per tooth family from official train scans only
Run QC and manifest; do not combine with FDI-16 until author reply
Benchmark segmentation extraction quality against Teeth3DS evaluation metrics on a tiny held-out set
pilotProposal.phaseB: Full train cohort after permission — target family-balanced train pool from official train crowns post-QC, keep official test sealed

citations: Ben-Hamadou et al., Teeth3DS: a benchmark for teeth segmentation and labeling from intra-oral 3D scans, arXiv:2210.06094, 2022.
Ben-Hamadou et al., 3DTeethSeg'22: 3D Teeth Scan Segmentation and Labeling Challenge, arXiv:2305.18277, 2023.

authorEmailDraft.subject: Non-commercial research use of Teeth3DS for TRELLIS.2 dental shape-prior fine-tuning
bodyPoints: Project: DentalSculptor — non-commercial dental education research pilot
Goal: Improve photo-to-3D tooth morphology across all permanent FDI classes using TRELLIS.2 shape-flow fine-tuning
Planned use: Extract per-tooth crowns from official Teeth3DS_split train set only; keep official test sealed; preserve patient-level splits
ND clarification requested: Is internal extraction of crown meshes and private non-commercial fine-tuning (candidate weights not publicly released) permitted under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0?
Attribution: Will cite Teeth3DS papers and OSF DOI in all publications and internal manifests
